meta.method: Original MFL events and rules for Native; cached nflfastR statistics and the audited ADL26 engine for historical Current Scoring. Missing archived MFL events are reconstructed under original rules and explicitly labeled. Recorded totals are retained independently. Ownership uses actual starters and weekly roster snapshots, NFC first. Zero-value relevant scoring categories remain visible.
